mentions.name: Turing machine replacement computing system
mentions.description: A computing system designed to replace the Turing machine, centered on performing computations via addressing. It includes a space emulator published in 2024 in which computations can be performed using addressing, and a parallel addressing mechanism based on a sorting network published in 2025.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a computing system that would replace the Turing machine. In 2024, I published a space emulator in which computations can be performed using addressing. In 2025, I published a parallel addressing mechanism based on a sorting network.
